context_for_next_testing_agent: Git shallow-clone/push regression is fully fixed and verified. /app has full history (unshallowed), origin points to https://github.com/dean06greif-ai/Krypto_Trader.git, .env files are gitignored and untracked. The technical push capability is confirmed via local bare-repo simulation — the actual Emergent 'Save to GitHub' can only be triggered by the user with their credentials. rca of the issue: Original 500 on 'Save to GitHub' was caused by /app being a shallow clone (git clone --depth 1) missing historical objects, which caused 'remote unpack failed: index-pack failed / did not receive expected object e9e7f06...'. Additionally the failed platform push had removed the origin remote. Main agent's fix (re-add origin + git fetch --unshallow) restored full object history. Verified by successful local bare-repo push with clean fsck on both source and destination.
